user.title: Connect your Kerbl IoT account
user.description: Sign in with your Kerbl IoT e-mail and password. Only the resulting access and refresh tokens are stored afterwards – your password itself is never saved.

reauth_confirm.title: Reauthenticate Kerbl IoT
reauth_confirm.description: The stored session for {email} is no longer valid. Enter your password again to refresh it.

error.cannot_connect: Could not connect to the Kerbl IoT service.

abort.already_configured: This Kerbl IoT account is already configured.
